objects.name: TraderTraitor
objects.description: North Korea (DPRK). U.S. government assesses it as state-sponsored; reporting places it within the Lazarus Group umbrella (ATT&CK G0032). Motive: Revenue generation for the state through theft of cryptocurrency. Targets: Centralized exchanges, wallet and custody providers, cross-chain bridge infrastructure, and the developers, DevOps engineers and signers who can reach them. Increasingly their third-party software vendors.
goals: Steal cryptocurrency to fund the DPRK state

objects.name: DMM Bitcoin (2024-05)

objects.name: Binance (2026-10-29)
objects.description: Control of hot-wallet signing infrastructure. On Ethereum, one transaction carried 50 EIP-7702 authorizations that turned the hot wallet into an attacker-controlled sweeper; most funds left in about 20 minutes. Binance first pointed to a compromised engineer's laptop, then 'additional points of breach'. Loss: $6,360,000,000.
